atoms.a: In this food web, most animals are producers.
There are several food chains within a food web.

text: This picture shows a food chain.
The gazelle eats grass, and the hyena eats the gazelle. Therefore, the food chain goes from grass to gazelle to hyena.

atoms.a: This food web shows how energy moves from producers to consumers.
The tree is the only producer in this food web.

instruction.text: Where does the blackberry bush get the energy it needs to grow from? Select the correct item in the food web.

finish.text: The blackberry bush is a producer and gets its energy to grow from the Sun.
The bear is an omnivorous consumer and gets its energy from different plants and animals, like berries, squirrels and deer.
